project_info.theme: Shopee 7.7 winner announcement for electric scooters

main_subject.detail: A widescreen stage-style poster announcing winners with text 'DA CO NGUOI MAY MAN TRUNG' and giant yellow headline '77 XE MAY DIEN'. Five glossy orange-and-white retro electric scooters stand on a circular lit stage, with one large center scooter facing front. The top-right corner has a bold '77' badge. Floating discount tickets, golden shopping bags, and trophy statues decorate the sides.
main_subject.style: Grand prize-announcement visual with 3D showroom staging, dramatic lighting, and symmetrical product display

composition_elements.text: DA CO NGUOI MAY MAN TRUNG / 77 XE MAY DIEN / 77
items: Top Left: White Shopee logo and orange percent ticket
Top Right: Large 77 badge and another orange percent ticket
Bottom Left: Gold trophy statue and floating Shopee shopping bag icon
Bottom Right: Matching gold trophy statue and more stage graphics
Center/Background: Circular red stage with spotlights, five retro electric scooters arranged symmetrically, and a dark red awards-show backdrop

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Multiple overhead spotlights, glossy scooter reflections, warm stage glow, cinematic contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Shopee winner announcement. Centerpiece is a symmetrical lineup of five glossy orange-and-white electric scooters on a circular illuminated stage, with the largest scooter front and center. Background is a dark red awards-show environment with spotlights. Surrounding elements: white Shopee logo, giant headline 'DA CO NGUOI MAY MAN TRUNG 77 XE MAY DIEN', top-right '77' badge, floating orange discount tickets, gold trophy statues, and Shopee shopping bag icons. Technical style: 3D prize-announcement poster with showroom compositing, dramatic awards-show lighting, glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
